about: Every visual stage of the characters, oldest first: milestones, review rounds and fixes. scripts/timeline.mjs (track "characters") turns this into timeline.gif. Add a stage with every visual commit; never overwrite a stage's picture. A commit cannot name itself, so the newest stage says "next" until the following commit fills in its hash.

stages.title: B1 · Units on the map
stages.note: Five pixel units a side; select, move range, path preview, walk, shared MOV pool.

stages.title: B8 · Layout round 1
stages.note: The map fills any screen in crisp pixels; the menu folds to a bar; the hand rests tucked and opens into a blurred focus mode with the card large in the middle.

stages.title: B8 · Map sprites, preview
stages.note: Aria, Corin and Bram hand-drawn in their battle costumes, at today's size and 1.3x taller, beside today's sprites (?sprites=detail, ?sprites=tall).

stages.title: B8 · Map sprites, finer pixels
stages.note: Aria polished at the map's pixel size beside Aria at twice the pixels each way in the same footprint, drawn in a second, finer pass (?sprites=fine).

stages.title: B8 · Pointing at a unit, and its window
stages.note: Hover and click pick the unit whose figure is under the pointer; the pointer floats over its head; a compact window with a portrait floats beside it. Portraits two ways: painted for the window, or cut from the battle art.

stages.title: B8 · All ten heroes drawn by hand
stages.note: Every hero on the map hand-drawn in their battle costume at the map's pixel size, breathing and striding; painted portraits for all ten in the unit window.

stages.title: B8 · The armies start a short march apart
stages.note: Every unit starts with a foe within 12 tiles' walk (and none closer than 4), the enemy towards the middle of the board, so both sides are on screen from the first turn.

stages.title: B8 · All In's gold pillars, and the weapon symbol in the unit window
stages.note: As King's Wager is played, a pillar of gold light ripples up through every unit whose gauge it fills, with one SKILL FULL over the side; the unit window shows the unit's weapon symbol before its class.

stages.title: B8 · SKILL READY: a sparkle by every full gauge
stages.note: A gold pixel sparkle twinkles by the head of every unit whose skill gauge is full, the foes' too. It shines when the card its side has in play can fire the skill and dims when it can't (another weapon's ACE, or All In); the unit window's gauge reads READY or SAVED.
